title: A Taxonomy of Challenges to Curating Fair Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews with ML dataset curators, focusing on their practical challenges in sourcing data from underrepresented regions and securing geographically diverse data collectors.

Qualitative thematic analysis of interviews with dataset curators, examining the challenges of addressing sexist stereotypes in web data, mitigating annotator-embedded gender biases, and defining inclusive gender taxonomies (e.g., beyond binary classifications in medical data).

Qualitative thematic analysis of curator interviews discussing the complexities of establishing fair racial taxonomies, noting the context-dependent nature of race (e.g., Western vs. South Asian contexts) and the difficulty of achieving balanced racial representation.

Qualitative thematic analysis of interviews with curators detailing the challenges of recruiting culturally knowledgeable annotators and avoiding the erasure of cultural nuances (e.g., African-American vernacular) during dataset quality filtering.

Qualitative thematic analysis of curator interviews addressing the limitations of training data availability for non-English languages (e.g., Arabic, Spanish) and the risks of misinterpretation due to language barriers between curators and data workers.
